items.title: 奥德赛
items.overview: 改编自荷马史诗《奥德赛》。特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯历经艰险、踏上漫长归乡之旅。

items.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
items.overview: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？

items.title: 野兽之心
items.overview: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

items.title: 模范公民
items.overview: 失去记忆、对过往一片模糊的前警探史蒂文·贝，在一座偏僻农场接受失忆治疗，却遭遇日益加剧的敌意、诡异的监视，以及难以控制的本能。随着压力不断升级，他开始追查破碎现实背后的真相。

items.title: 哥斯拉-0.0
items.overview: 人类的罪与罚。已经，没法归零。战争将日本粉碎至“零”，哥斯拉的袭击更将它推至“负”的绝境。时间来到两年后，人民历尽痛苦磨难仍坚持复苏的步伐，看似终于可以回归正常生活……然而此时，巨兽再次袭来。它彻底摧毁这份希望，将人类推向新的绝望深渊！

related.title: 哥斯拉大战金刚2：帝国崛起

items.title: 黄金时段
items.overview: 聚焦电视主持人克里斯·汉森与他推出的一档真人秀节目“猎捕恋童癖”，该节目利用人员在网络上伪装成未成年人，引诱恋童癖进入摄影棚，并将其逮捕。

items.title: 假如爱有如果
items.overview: 《假如爱有如果》讲述了两对已婚夫妇之间错综复杂的关系；他们各自面临着不同的人生抉择，内心也深藏着不为人知的渴望。美玉（全度妍饰）与失业的丈夫浩锡（薛景求饰）及年幼的儿子崔铁，直到一场葬礼让他们与纪录片导演艺智（曹汝贞饰）及其丈夫尚宇（赵寅成饰）产生交集。艺智正在拍摄失业工人的生活，而她与尚宇优渥的生活方式也与美玉一家形成鲜明对比。美玉答应接受拍摄后，逐渐与艺智亲近，也不由自主地被难以捉摸的尚宇吸引，心中充满不安。随着两个世界不断碰撞，他们看似平静的日常生活也开始出现裂痕。这是备受赞誉的导演李沧东（《燃烧》、《诗》、《密阳》）时隔八年推出的新作。他以标志性的细腻笔触呈现《假如爱有如果》中不断变化的情感、彼此交织的矛盾与截然不同的人生观，刻画这些关系中的微妙变化。

items.title: 猫鼬
items.overview: 一位被冤枉的战争英雄，一无所有，在昔日特种部队成员的帮助下，与警方展开了一场史诗般的全国汽车追逐，全程电视直播。而着迷的公众则密切关注着他，希望他能安全逃脱。

items.title: 罗摩衍那：王子传奇
items.overview: 改编自印度古代史诗《罗摩衍那》。魔王罗波那作恶多端，欲用武力一统三界。毗湿奴神化身罗摩降临凡尘，担起守护众生的重任。十四年流放间罗摩降妖除魔，一步步激怒了罗波那。当妻子悉多被掳走，彻底点燃了罗摩心中的战意。

items.title: 不存在的罪人
items.overview: 改编自科琳·胡佛的同名小说。知名作家维莉蒂·克劳福德因意外受伤后，洛温·阿什利受聘代笔完成她的系列小说，并搬进克劳福德家中。洛温意外发现维莉蒂令人不安的自传手稿，逐渐陷入真假难辨的秘密、操纵与执念之中。

cast.name: 伊斯梅尔·克鲁斯·科尔多瓦

related.title: 路易·德拉克斯的第九条命

items.title: 泥面人
items.overview: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。

items.title: 末世行者
items.overview: 改编自彼得·海勒的同名小说。在残酷的末世中，年轻飞行员希格与军事生存专家班格利建立了一个与世隔绝的居所。当一段神秘的无线电信号传来，希格决定踏入未知世界，寻找他仍然相信存在的希望与人性。

items.title: 天启Z：新世界
items.overview: TSJ病毒爆发后，加纳利群岛成了欧洲最后的避难所。当一支任务小队前往马德里搜寻物资，罗贝托怀着可疑的动机加入。遭遇感染者后，团队意见出现分歧，他们在奋力求生的同时还面临道德两难：自保或为了残存的人性赌上一切？

items.title: 野马九号
items.overview: 1973年智利，性格迥异的CIA特工克里斯和李被局长从圣地亚哥派往复活节岛，这对搭档将执行一项考验彼此信任和忠诚的任务。

items.title: 复仇者联盟5：毁灭之日
items.overview: 来自三个截然不同宇宙的传奇英雄们，将被推向一场生死对决，并最终直面一股前所未见、足以撼动万物存亡的终极威胁。

profile.tagline: 选择皆有代价，毁灭将至，终局未定。

related.title: 少年泰坦出击大战少年泰坦
钢铁侠与美国队长：英雄集结

items.title: 痴迷
items.overview: 一个渴望爱情的浪漫主义者打破神秘的“许愿柳”，希望赢得心仪之人的芳心。当愿望如愿实现，他却发现，有些欲望背后隐藏着黑暗而可怕的代价。

items.title: 荒野丛林
items.overview: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。

items.title: 狗狗的完美圣诞节
items.overview: 影片改编自《一条狗的使命》系列作者W·布鲁斯·卡梅伦的同名小说。一次医疗紧急状况导致戈斯一家四分五裂，意志坚定的狗狗温斯特决定竭尽全力，赶在平安夜前让家人重聚。

items.title: 戴帽子的猫
items.overview: 改编自苏斯博士创作的同名儿童绘本。一只古灵精怪的猫接到最艰巨的任务：帮助一对因搬家而闷闷不乐的兄妹加比和塞巴斯蒂安重拾快乐。这场充满魔法与恶作剧的冒险，也可能成为他证明自己的最后机会，否则就将失去魔法帽。

items.title: 希望
items.overview: 支援人员前往扑救山火，通讯也随之中断。湖浦派出所所长范锡与警员成爱奋力保护村中老人，而进入山中追踪怪物的成基等人反遭猎杀。由无知引发的灾难逐渐演变为一场席卷宇宙的悲剧.

related.title: 疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路

items.title: 再婚皇后
items.overview: 深受爱戴的皇后娜菲尔，与皇帝索本修一同治理着东大帝国。当索本修爱上逃亡奴隶菈丝塔，并要求与娜菲尔离婚时，娜菲尔答应了，但提出一个条件，她必须获得再婚许可，嫁给西王国王子海因里。

profile.tagline: 我同意离婚，但是请同意让我再婚

items.title: 黑鸽
items.overview: 嫁给政客的卧底间谍依靠多年好友兼职业杀手的协助完成秘密行动，如履薄冰地维系自己的双重生活。

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: 两大黑帮家族的权力争斗将伦敦地下世界卷入战争。作为哈里根家族的“解决者”，哈里·达·索萨周旋于家族、敌人和日益失控的内部矛盾之间。

items.title: 幻视任务
items.overview: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。

items.title: 研究院
items.overview: 《迷失》导演杰克·本德与《大小谎言》)编剧大卫·E·凯利将把史蒂芬·金最新小说《研究院》打造为限定剧。本剧将由本德执导，凯利执笔剧本，据悉小说被描述为“自《小丑回魂》问世以来，有关孩子战胜邪恶的最令人揪心的故事”。

items.title: 嗜血法医：杀魔复生
items.overview: 迈阿密血迹分析师德克斯特·摩根以连环杀手为目标，在隐藏真实身份的同时，继续遵循自己的杀戮准则，并面对儿子哈里森及过往带来的种种纠葛。

profile.tagline: 他还活着，而且表现超神。

items.title: 末路兼职
items.overview: 负债累累的年轻男子接下了一家神秘机构提供的高薪兼职工作，却发现为了赚更多钱干的这份差事竟变成了一场噩梦。

items.title: Lupin
items.overview: 灵感源自莫里斯·勒布朗创作的亚森·罗宾系列小说。绅士怪盗阿桑·迪奥普受到亚森·罗宾冒险的启发，凭借智慧与魅力智胜敌人，保护所爱之人。

items.title: Campus Drivers
items.overview:
Lois成功考入知名的贝尔罗斯大学，本来准备和挚爱男友Max开启校园新生活。

　　Lane是校园爆火 App「Campus Drivers」的创始人，长相迷人，但害怕稳定的亲密关系。

　　一场失恋风波，心碎的Lois意外来到Lane家门口，两人开启"意外同居"。来自两个完全不同世界的男女，产生无法抵挡的吸引力。这场相遇唤醒两人深埋的过往伤痛，当爱情不请自来，一切都充满变数。

related.title: 我与沃尔特家男孩的生活

items.title: 夜曲
items.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

related.title: 好女孩的谋杀调查报告

items.title: The Greatest
items.overview: 1960年奥运会刚刚摘金，年轻拳击手穆罕默德阿里（当时名为卡修斯克莱）便将目光投向了重量级冠军。面对突如其来的名声、自我怀疑、家庭矛盾以及政治动荡的美国，这位百年一遇的天才发现，他最强大的对手不在拳台之上，而在这个尚未准备好让他成为真正自己的社会之中。

items.title: 午夜规则
items.original_title: กฎหลังเที่ยงคืน
items.overview: 梅塔是一个背负着无法抹去过往的男人，在失去全部家人和原本应有的未来后，独自艰难抚养女儿。经济压力所迫，他接受了一份便利店夜班工作。起初这看似只是一份普通差事，但很快他便发现这家便利店隐藏着诸多难以预料的神秘之处，而店里的“规则”远非寻常。

items.title: 巴斯X机甲
items.overview: 在西部蒸汽朋克世界中，法外之徒、机器与超自然力量肆虐横行，一位父亲被迫身兼法官、陪审团与刽子手，只为保护自己的家人。

items.title: 现在就出发
items.overview: 《现在就出发》是由腾讯视频出品，一生向扬联合出品出的户外真人秀 。节目一方面为观众展现了祖国引人入胜的山河风光、自然美景，另一方面展现出嘉宾们与大自然相处的生活观，带领观众一起逃离都市水泥森林，打造秘境里的充电之旅。

related.title: Check It Out! with Dr. Steve Brule

items.title: Stick
items.overview: 前职业高尔夫球手普莱斯·卡希尔在职业生涯受挫、婚姻破裂后，决定培养一名天赋出众却问题缠身的17岁少年桑提。在高尔夫球场内外，两人逐渐建立起特殊的关系，也各自寻找人生的新方向。

items.title: 黑色五叶草
items.overview: 两个孤儿一起长大，情同手足，却为争夺这个世界最高的魔法等级“魔法帝”的称号成为了对手。

related.title: 妖精的尾巴 百年任务
勇者斗恶龙 达伊的大冒险

items.title: 嫁金钗
items.overview: 改编自笑佳人的同名小说。阿丑因容貌酷似侯府千金，意外成为国公府世子陆濯的冲喜新娘。陆濯苏醒后对她百般提防，另一名与她容貌相同的女子也对她恨之入骨。身处危机四伏的国公府，阿丑步步谋划，逐渐改写命运，并揭开身世之谜。

items.title: 航海王
items.overview: 拥有财富、名声、势力，拥有整个世界的海贼王 – 哥尔·D·罗杰，他在临刑前的一句话，让人们趋之若鹜奔向大海。“想要我的财宝吗？想要的话可以全部给你，去找吧！我把所有财宝都放在那里。”于是所有男子汉航向伟大的航路追逐梦想，世界开始迎接“大海贼时代”。

items.overview: 一名神秘且出色的外科医生来到一家人人自大、腐败横行的医院，面对强烈的反对，接手看似无法医治的病例。

items.title: 塔尔萨之王
items.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

items.title: 魔法秘境
items.overview: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。

items.title: 时间里的爱人
items.overview: 阿尔穆特与托比亚斯因一次意外相遇，人生从此改变。两人相恋、组建家庭，在时间的考验与生活的变故中，学会珍惜彼此相伴的每一刻。

超级大坏蛋短片：毁灭按钮
赛车总动员：板牙狂想曲

items.title: 向阳青春
items.overview: 高中生夏薇零（肖雨晴 饰），长期困在母亲（李颖 饰） 的严密管控里，学业、选择、交友全都被安排妥当。曾经顺从的她，终于在压抑里爆发，逃课、反抗，和好友宋飞（张恒铭 饰）、陆欢（张婧岚 饰）一起，拼命夺回属于自己的空间。母女之间争吵不断，误会层层叠加，那句沉甸甸的 “我都是为了你”，慢慢变成刺伤彼此的利刃。一边是母亲寄托全部人生的期待，一边是女孩想要自主成长的渴望。这场没有赢家的家庭战争，能否找到和解的出口？这是属于无数青春期孩子的挣扎，也是每个家长都要面对的一课。

items.title: 深度安静
items.overview: 影片改编自林秀赫同名短篇小说。讲述谕明与依庭相遇于大学图书馆里的深度安静区，两人相爱并走入婚姻，正期待迎接第一个孩子。然而，依庭的意外自杀让谕明陷入混乱与痛苦。他想起依庭在怀孕后变得异常，甚至提出离婚。自责的谕明照顾起依庭的家人，透过深入了解她的家庭后，开始理解她的行径，以及她无法面对自己父亲的原因，真相却让人难以接受。

items.title: 霹雳英雄：素还真
items.overview: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

items.title: 夫妻一场
items.overview: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

related.title: 安娜·妮可·史密斯：你们不了解我

items.title: 试探
items.overview: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

items.title: 孤楼夜幽灵
items.overview: 女子林欣因一次意外而丧失记忆，雨夜，别墅里发生诡异事件，女儿失踪。二十年过去，林欣恢复记忆，再次回到女儿失踪的地方，找到女儿，揭开了二十年前发生在母女亲情背后的真相。

items.title: 骇人命案事件簿
items.overview: 《骇人命案事件簿》是英国独立电视台制作的一部长青推理电影集，取材于英国当代推理小说家Caroline Graham的作品，该剧以总督察Tom Barnaby以及他的年轻拍档Troy为主干，讲述二人凭借机智抽丝剥茧，悉破复杂凶案的故事 ，此外这两个人在查案过程中所不时表现出的幽默机智、亦庄亦谐也是此片受欢迎的原因之一。全剧在英国南部白金汉郡取景拍摄，漂亮的小村庄充满了浓浓的英伦风味，与命案本身的骇人听闻形成强烈反衬，为英式推理迷以及克里斯蒂小说爱好者们的必看之作。

items.title: 斗破苍穹
items.overview:
萧炎曾是家族里公认的斗气天才，年仅11岁便已经抵达了常人穷尽一生都无法修炼到的境界。可12岁那年，一场意外让萧炎的全部努力都化为了乌有，失去一切的他体会到了人情的冷暖和世态的炎凉，之后，萧炎和纳兰嫣然许下了决斗的三年之约，来到魔兽山脉，在身世神秘的药老手下修炼。三年间，萧炎的身影穿梭在塔戈尔大沙漠和加玛帝国黑岩城等地，结识了云芝、小医仙等志同道合的好友，并且最终获得了强大的力量。三年一晃眼就过去了，萧炎毫无悬念的战胜了纳兰嫣然，却没想到，他的故事和劫难才刚刚开始。

剧情发展观看顺序：特别篇4（缘起篇）- 第一季 - 特别篇1（邂逅云芝篇）- 第二季 - 特别篇2（沙之澜歌）- 第三季 - 第四季 - 特别篇3（三年之约）- 第五季（年番）

items.title: 上帝之城：斗争蔓延
items.original_title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
items.overview: 聚焦里约热内卢贫民区的残酷故事，“魔鬼也会叹息着转身的地方”。这部新的剧集继续由电影版导演费尔南多·梅里尔斯打造，他透露：电影讲的是当地社区的缺陷，剧版则将讲述这些社区的力量。

items.title: Overgeared
items.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

items.title: 夜樱家的大作战
items.overview:
「这个家庭非比寻常！？」　

高中生「朝野太阳」，因为事故而痛失了家人，心灵也因此变得十分封闭。在班上的同学，大家对他的印象都是”超．内向”，唯一能够与之交谈的是他的青梅竹马「夜樱六美」，但是六美却有一个秘密！？

她的真实身份是代代相传的间谍家族的当家，还一直受到各种敌人性命的威胁。而且她的哥哥「凶一郎」是最凶狠的间谍，对六美表现出异常的溺爱。太阳发现，自己已经成为凶一郎“排除”的目标，生命岌岌可危…！

为了守护六美以及自己的性命安全，太阳采取的手段居然是与六美结婚，成为夜樱家的女婿！？

围绕着太阳、六美以及夜樱家前所未闻的「大作战」让人目不转睛！

items.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
items.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

items.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

items.title: 仙逆
items.overview: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。

items.title: 羞耻(克罗地亚版)
items.overview: 该剧以克罗地亚首都萨格勒布为背景，将于2024年秋季开始在HRT1上播出。

items.title: Fool in Love
items.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

items.title: 牧神记
items.overview: 主角秦牧，幼时被一女尸托举至涌江边并被司婆婆捡到，村长根据玉佩上的字为其取名为“秦牧”。被一只母牛哺乳长大，是天生凡体，但被村长骗为霸体，修炼霸体三丹功。后走出大墟闯荡，进入京城，拜入太学院。历经考验成为天魔教教主，并被延康国封为第一任太学博士。秦牧在延康国叛乱之战中引来魔神，掀起浩荡风云，后随武可汗入楼兰黄金宫，一个人打遍圣宫无敌手，麻翻无数大巫，盗走无数珍宝。后返回延康，助国师平叛、入京城斩杀太子、造射日神炮。秦牧得人皇传承成为新一代人皇。机缘巧合下遇到了亲生父亲，揭开了自己的身世，借助道门小玉京等人的帮助，开启了道法神通改革的大世。一步步逐渐成长，作为延康变法三杰之一，为芸芸众生而战。

items.title: Tigers Sniff the Rose
items.overview: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

items.title: 辛普森一家
items.overview: 辛普森一家是来自美国普通的五口之家，荷马是春田镇核能工厂的安全检查员，母亲马芝曾经是一个很有思想的女性，自从嫁给荷马后渐渐地适应了主妇生活的定式。巴特是家中的长子，天性顽皮的巴特经常爱玩一些恶作剧，以至于经常惹麻烦。妹妹丽莎是一个很聪明的孩子，同时还是素食主义者，佛教徒，爵士乐。小女马姬是一个永远长不大的孩子。故事设定于虚构小镇春田镇，从许多角度对美国的文化与社会、人的条件和电视本身进行了幽默的嘲讽，经久不衰。

items.title: 研究院
items.overview: 《迷失》导演杰克·本德与《大小谎言》)编剧大卫·E·凯利将把史蒂芬·金最新小说《研究院》打造为限定剧。本剧将由本德执导，凯利执笔剧本，据悉小说被描述为“自《小丑回魂》问世以来，有关孩子战胜邪恶的最令人揪心的故事”。

items.title: 镀金时代
items.overview: 镀金时代是经济上经历剧变的时期，在新旧钱财来来去去之际，伴随而来的是日益严重的贫富不均。在这变化莫测的时代背景下，本故事始于1882年，年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克是联邦军将领之女，在父亲过世后成了孤儿并搬到纽约的爱格·凡瑞恩和艾达·布鲁克姑姑家。在她身边的还有位才华洋溢，名叫佩姬·史考特的黑人女性。玛丽安不经意地被卷入了姑姑与邻居的社交争斗中。前者是继承大量遗产的名门后代，后者则是坐拥巨额财富且冷酷无情的铁路大亨与其野心勃勃的妻子，乔治与宝莎·罗素。在这新旧交替之际，玛丽安是会循着旧传统的规矩，或是开创新的道路呢？

items.title: 库比蒂诺
items.overview: 一名律师遭前雇主科技初创公司侵吞股票期权。他拒绝妥协，与另一名刚被解雇的律师联手创办律所，帮助遭科技巨头侵害的人们维权，向掌控硅谷的强大企业发起挑战。

items.title: 动物管制官
items.overview:
《废柴联盟》男主Joel McHale将领衔FOX这部半小时工作地点单镜头喜剧。

本剧由《穆迪一家》主创Bob Fisher与Rob Greenberg，《全民追女王》编剧Dan Sterling共同打造。

顾名思义，本剧将围绕着一群负责动物管制官的日常工作和生活展开，所有人都在复杂的工作中认清了一个事实：动物是简单的，而人不是。

Joel将在剧中饰演“Frank”，一个固执、古怪的动物管制官，他或许没有上过大学，但仍然是房间里最博学的人。作为一名曾经的警员，Frank当时试图揭露自己部门的腐败事件缺最终导致他被解雇。这或许可以解释为什么他如此愤世嫉俗和脾气暴躁。在理解动物的方面，Frank展示了过人的能力；但面对同类…他或许不是那么精通。

《疯狂前女友》“Heather”Vella Lovell饰演“Emily”，一个招人喜欢、但偶尔也会有点迟钝尴尬的动物管制团队队长。尽管Emily偶尔在工作中不知所措，但她被自己的队员们深爱着。

《喜当爷》“Ravi”Ravi Patel饰演“Amit Patel”，也同样是团队中的一员；Amit是个不堪重负的居家型男人，承担的家庭责任超出了他的预期。他的搭档与他的生活方式截然不同，彼此可能来自不同的星球。

items.title: 梅格雷探案
items.overview: 《梅格雷探案》是由PBS制作的悬疑犯罪剧集，讲述本杰明·温赖特（《贝尔格莱维亚：新篇章》《指环王：洛希林之战》）饰演朱尔斯·梅格雷——巴黎精英警队“La Crim”的负责人，负责调查巴黎及其周边地区的重大犯罪案件。梅格雷是一位与众不同的年轻探员，渴望证明自己的能力。他调查时锲而不舍，拥有洞察罪犯心理的非凡直觉，以及对巴黎与其居民无与伦比的了解。

items.title: 金银岛
items.overview: 改编自罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森的经典冒险小说。年轻的吉姆·霍金斯和母亲贝斯得到一张传说中的海盗藏宝图，由此踏上横渡大西洋的致命航程。面对叛变、暴力与背叛，吉姆必须在危机四伏的旅途中成长，而这段经历也将彻底改变他的人生。

items.title: 心灵之地
items.overview: 在艾伯塔省山脚下弗莱明斯的牧场上，生活很艰难，在那里受虐待或被忽视的马匹在一个善良而勤奋的家庭中寻求庇护。 负债累累，银行即将取消抵押品赎回权。 他们可以保持牧场运转吗？

items.title: 格里姆斯堡
items.overview: 马文·弗洛特可能是有史以来最伟大的侦探，但他仍然无法解开一个谜团：他的家人，他将遵循每一条线索，与他从未停止过爱的前妻一起救赎自己。

items.title: 东区人
items.overview: 阿尔伯特广场（Albert Square）的工人阶级居民的日常生活，阿尔伯特广场是维多利亚时代的传统露台露台，周围环绕着伦敦沃尔福德区东端的一个公园。

items.title: Universal Basic Guys
items.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

items.title: 极道寿司次郎！
items.overview: 故事背景为近未来的洛杉矶，整座城市被“美食秩序”彻底掌控：顶级主厨的权势堪比黑帮大佬，餐厅就是各方势力的权力中心，为了拿下顶级餐厅的一席位，有人不惜突破底线，不同的烹饪理念更是分化出针锋相对的派系。

items.title: Crossroad Springs
items.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

items.title: 艾玛镇
items.overview: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

items.title: 加冕街
items.overview: 英国播放时间最长的超级电视肥皂剧（ITV台）。因五十周年剧庆，编剧让其临时转型为灾难剧，目前全街处于灾后重建阶段。

items.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
items.overview: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.
items.episode_title: I think we should be buds

items.title: 联邦调查局
items.overview: 本剧讲述美国联邦调查局纽约办公室的精英团队为保证纽约和国家安全，发挥他们丰富的才能、才智和技术专长的故事。

items.title: 中央情报局

items.title: NCIS
items.overview: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it's a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Leroy Jethro Gibbs, a former Marine gunnery sergeant, whose skills as an investigator are unmatched, leads this troupe of colorful personalities. Rounding out the team are Anthony DiNozzo, an ex-homicide detective whose instincts in the field are unparalleled and whose quick wit and humorous take on life make him a team favorite; the youthful and energetic forensic specialist Abby Sciuto, a talented scientist whose sharp mind matches her Goth style and eclectic tastes; Caitlin Todd, an ex-Secret Service Agent; and Timothy McGee, an MIT graduate whose brilliance with computers far overshadows his insecurities in the field; Assisting the team is medical examiner Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard, who knows it all because he's seen it all, and he's not afraid to let you know. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents travel the globe to investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

As tensions rise and rivalries deepen, there are spilled secrets, forged alliances, and snatched liaisons that draw wives, lovers, colleagues, friends, and families into their battle.

These are their stories.

And there's the Intelligence Unit, the team that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond. These are their stories.

items.overview: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

items.overview: Elsbeth follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

items.title: Law & Order
items.overview: In the criminal justice system, the people are represented by two separate, yet equally important, groups: the police, who investigate crime; and the district attorneys, who prosecute the offenders. These are their stories.

items.title: Grey's Anatomy
items.overview: The doctors of Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital deal with life-or-death consequences on a daily basis -- it's in one another that they find comfort, friendship and, at times, more than friendship. Together they're discovering that neither medicine nor relationships can be defined in black and white. Real life only comes in shades of grey.

items.title: Tulsa King
items.overview: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

items.title: Nocturne
items.overview: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: With the most powerful clients in Europe, MobLand will see family fortunes and reputations at risk, odd alliances unfold, and betrayal around every corner; and while the family might be London's most elite fixers today, the nature of their business means there is no guarantee what's in store tomorrow.MobLand follows two generations of gangsters, the businesses they run, the complex relationships they weave and the man they call upon to fix their problem.

items.title: Dexter: Resurrection
items.overview: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

items.title: Mistletoe Murders
items.overview: Emily Lane is a good-natured Christmas shop owner with a secret past. When local murders begin to pop up in Fletcher's Grove, Emily can't help but to use her unique talents from her past life to help solve murders that affect people in her new life. She crosses paths with Detective Sam Wilner who she starts to make a connection with, until he comes to learn there is more to Emily than meets the eye.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.overview: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

items.title: War
items.overview: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.

items.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
items.overview: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.

items.title: The Good Daughter
items.overview: The Good Daughter is a suspenseful crime drama where sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she's forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

items.title: Sheriff Country
items.overview: Sheriff Country focuses on straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire's division chief Sharon Leone, who investigates criminal activity as she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father, Wes, who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

items.title: Fire Country
items.overview: In Fire Country, seeking redemption and a shortened prison sentence, young convict Bode Donovan joins a firefighting program that returns him to his small Northern California hometown, where he and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region.

items.title: The Rainmaker
items.overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head-to-head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend. Rudy, along with his boss and her disheveled paralegal, uncover two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

items.title: Boston Blue
items.overview: In Boston Blue, NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with Detective Lena Silver, the eldest daughter of a prominent law enforcement family.

items.title: Happy's Place

items.title: Newlyweds

items.title: Yaga

Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

items.title: 综合医院
items.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

items.original_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
items.english_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
items.overview:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

items.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
items.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 用【循环利息】强制收回借出的魔力
items.original_title: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu
items.english_title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
items.overview:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!
(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

items.title: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる
items.original_title: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
items.overview:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.

items.title: 萤火虫的出嫁
items.overview:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

items.title: ロメリア戦記 〜魔王を倒した後も人類やばそうだから軍隊組織した〜
items.original_title: Romelia Senki: Maou wo Taoshita nochi mo Jinrui Yabasou dakara Guntai Soshiki Shita
items.overview:
Romelia and her party succeed in defeating the Demon King Zelgis, though Prince Henri’s reckless charge forces them into a grueling battle. In the aftermath, Romelia is branded "dead weight" for not fighting directly, and the Prince unilaterally breaks off their engagement. Denied a place in the victory celebrations, Romelia returns home, only to be met with cold indifference from her family and society. Yet, she refuses to break. She has already set her sights on the path that lies ahead.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: Romelia War Chronicle streamed 2 days in advance of the TV broadcast on AnimeTimes, U-NEXT, and Netflix beginning October 3, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on October 5, 2026.

items.overview:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site, Official Twitter)

items.title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE
items.original_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
items.english_title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
items.overview:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

items.title: 转生后的大圣女，极力隐瞒圣女的身分
items.original_title: Tensei shita Dai Seijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hita Kakusu
items.english_title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
items.overview:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: The series streamed a week in advance on ABEMA, Prime Video, and Crunchyroll starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.

items.title: 冰之城墙 第二季
items.overview:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… 

(Source: Netflix)

items.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

items.title: 朱色假面
items.overview:
"The Mask” gives power to anyone who wears it.

At times, that means endless possibility, or unimaginable tragedy…

Peru, pupil of the legendary mask maker Gaston Roux, becomes controlled by the “Mask of the Warrior God,” and unintentionally kills his friends, and even his own master.

In order to prevent this type of tragedy from reoccurring, Peru swears to destroy all of Gaston’s masks that are spread around the world. Confronting the sins that he has committed, he embarks on his voyage. Meeting new friends, then confronting powerful foes. The boy continues on. Until the day he can atone for his sins against his master.

(Source: The Vermillion Mask English Site)

items.english_title: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-
items.overview:
The Seido baseball club has been invited to the spring invitational at the hallowed Koshien Stadium. Sawamura will finally stand on the mound! Standing between Seido and the national title are the winners of last year's summer tournament Komadai Fujimaki and their unstoppable ace Masamune Hongo. Can Seido triumph over Komadai? It's the start of another heated battle in youth baseball!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.original_title: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
items.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
items.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

items.title: 桃源暗鬼 日光・華厳の滝編
items.english_title: TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
items.overview:
After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro."

When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls…

(Source: REMOW)

items.title: デモンズ・クレスト
items.overview:
Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she’s since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game’s horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same…and staying alive is just the beginning!

(Source: Yen Press)

items.english_title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
items.overview:
Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 某暗部的少女共栖
items.overview:
This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.

In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public.

"ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps.

Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...!

This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

items.title: 恐怖收集者
items.overview:
Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day…

(Source: Yen Press)

items.title: 转生哥布林有问题吗？
items.english_title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
items.overview:
Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on ABEMA and Prime Video beginning with episode 2 on October 5th, 2026

items.title: 你好，我是受心上人所托来做恋爱药的魔女。
items.original_title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
items.english_title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
items.overview:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)

items.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
items.overview: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？

items.title: 野兽之心
items.overview: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

items.title: 奥德赛
items.overview: 改编自荷马史诗《奥德赛》。特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯历经艰险、踏上漫长归乡之旅。

items.title: 黄金时段
items.overview: 聚焦电视主持人克里斯·汉森与他推出的一档真人秀节目“猎捕恋童癖”，该节目利用人员在网络上伪装成未成年人，引诱恋童癖进入摄影棚，并将其逮捕。

items.title: 不存在的罪人
items.overview: 改编自科琳·胡佛的同名小说。知名作家维莉蒂·克劳福德因意外受伤后，洛温·阿什利受聘代笔完成她的系列小说，并搬进克劳福德家中。洛温意外发现维莉蒂令人不安的自传手稿，逐渐陷入真假难辨的秘密、操纵与执念之中。

cast.name: 伊斯梅尔·克鲁斯·科尔多瓦

related.title: 路易·德拉克斯的第九条命

items.title: 末世行者
items.overview: 改编自彼得·海勒的同名小说。在残酷的末世中，年轻飞行员希格与军事生存专家班格利建立了一个与世隔绝的居所。当一段神秘的无线电信号传来，希格决定踏入未知世界，寻找他仍然相信存在的希望与人性。

items.title: 蜘蛛侠：崭新之日
items.overview: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》事件四年后，世界已经忘记了彼得·帕克的存在。他独自生活在纽约，将全部精力投入打击犯罪，成为一名全职蜘蛛侠。然而，看着昔日好友各自开启新的生活，长期的孤独与日益沉重的责任让彼得承受着巨大的压力，他的身体也开始发生难以控制的异常变化。与此同时，一名行踪难以察觉的强大敌人正悄然威胁着纽约及他所珍视的人。面对身体的异变与不断逼近的危机，彼得不得不独自迎接新的挑战……

profile.tagline: 纵使被遗忘，依然在守护。

related.title: 蚁人与黄蜂女：量子狂潮

items.title: 猫鼬
items.overview: 一位被冤枉的战争英雄，一无所有，在昔日特种部队成员的帮助下，与警方展开了一场史诗般的全国汽车追逐，全程电视直播。而着迷的公众则密切关注着他，希望他能安全逃脱。

items.title: 小丑回魂：德里故事
items.overview: 《小丑回魂：欢迎来到德里镇》的衍生特别篇。数百年前，在潘尼怀斯出现之前，三个孩子深入西部森林，并在那里遭遇一个可怕的远古灵体。

items.title: 天启Z：新世界
items.overview: TSJ病毒爆发后，加纳利群岛成了欧洲最后的避难所。当一支任务小队前往马德里搜寻物资，罗贝托怀着可疑的动机加入。遭遇感染者后，团队意见出现分歧，他们在奋力求生的同时还面临道德两难：自保或为了残存的人性赌上一切？

items.title: 忘却之岛
items.overview: 好友乔与拉伊萨高中毕业即将分别，她们打算相伴度过最后一夜，却意外被传送到奇幻岛屿纳卡利。二人得知重返家园的代价是抹去关于彼此的全部记忆，她们必须抓紧时间，在遗忘对方找到方法离开这座岛屿。

related.title: 小马国女孩 被遗忘的友谊

items.title: 为了你的母亲
items.original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
items.overview: 一个虔诚的杀手在杀人的工作、信仰和当父亲的责任之间挣扎，他要保护自己的孩子们，直面来袭的势力和濒临崩塌的信仰。

items.title: 阿里·G：我是谁？
items.overview: 过了二十年"躺平"、"嗨天嗨地"的生活后，阿里·G在震惊中得知他的长期女友朱莉已怀孕八个月。家里多了一张吃饭的嘴，阿里·G放弃了傻乐的日子，前往美国试图重拾昔日的辉煌。但他很快就遇到了对手，这个对手最终将威胁到他和他孩子的生存。

cast.name: 萨莎·拜伦·科恩
cast.character: Ali G / Nira Cain-N'Degeocello / Erran Morad

cast.name: 拉基姆·阿瑟尔斯通·梅耶斯

items.title: 痴迷
items.overview: 一个渴望爱情的浪漫主义者打破神秘的“许愿柳”，希望赢得心仪之人的芳心。当愿望如愿实现，他却发现，有些欲望背后隐藏着黑暗而可怕的代价。

items.title: 歪心狼对阵ACME
items.overview: 改编自1990年《纽约客》的一篇同名文章。饱受ACME产品故障之苦的歪心狼决定反击，与律师凯文·艾弗里联手，将这家唯利是图的跨国企业告上法庭。

related.title: 玛雅蜜蜂历险记2：蜜糖游戏
马达加斯加3：欧洲通缉犯

items.title: 逃出绝命街
items.overview: 居住在花谷街的一对夫妻，察觉到社区里发生了一些细微的变化。当一场剧烈的雷暴袭来后，他们连同他们的孩子和邻居醒来发现自己竟被“传送回了史前时代”，身边被恐龙和其他野生生物包围。

profile.tagline: 恐龙乍现 大开杀戒

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: 两大黑帮家族的权力争斗将伦敦地下世界卷入战争。作为哈里根家族的“解决者”，哈里·达·索萨周旋于家族、敌人和日益失控的内部矛盾之间。

items.title: 塔尔萨之王
items.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

items.title: 幻视任务
items.overview: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。

items.title: 嗜血法医：杀魔复生
items.overview: 迈阿密血迹分析师德克斯特·摩根以连环杀手为目标，在隐藏真实身份的同时，继续遵循自己的杀戮准则，并面对儿子哈里森及过往带来的种种纠葛。

profile.tagline: 他还活着，而且表现超神。

items.title: 黑色五叶草
items.overview: 两个孤儿一起长大，情同手足，却为争夺这个世界最高的魔法等级“魔法帝”的称号成为了对手。

related.title: 妖精的尾巴 百年任务
勇者斗恶龙 达伊的大冒险

items.title: 黑鸽
items.overview: 嫁给政客的卧底间谍依靠多年好友兼职业杀手的协助完成秘密行动，如履薄冰地维系自己的双重生活。

items.title: 夜曲
items.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

related.title: 好女孩的谋杀调查报告

items.title: 治安官之乡
items.overview: 《烈焰国度》衍生剧。直率的治安官米奇・福克斯驻守埃奇沃特小镇，巡逻侦办罪案，同时兼顾家庭难题。她既要面对有前科、私种大麻的父亲韦斯，也要守护宣誓捍卫的社区，应对持续升级的犯罪危机。

items.title: 实习医生格蕾
items.overview: 西雅图格雷斯医院迎来新一批实习生，梅雷迪斯·格雷、克里斯蒂娜·杨、伊泽贝尔·斯蒂文、乔治·梅利 、亚里克斯·卡莱，五个医学院好友同期毕业，需要以良好表现争夺住院医师正式席位。进入医院伊始，梅雷迪斯崩溃地发现前晚在酒吧和她发生一夜情的男人，竟然是神经外科医生德立克·舍伯，两人纠葛就此开始；克里斯蒂娜吸引了胸外科医师普雷斯顿·伯克的注意，因为他们同样高傲和野心勃勃；乔治悄悄爱着梅雷迪斯；美丽的伊泽贝尔第一时间掀起流言，一年的实习期注定充满高密度的压力竞争与荷尔蒙……

profile.tagline: 你拯救的生命也许将是你自己

items.title: 烈焰国度
items.overview: Bode Donovan 是一名年轻罪犯，曾经烧毁了他生命中的一切。为寻求救赎，Bode 加入了北加州一项非常规的监狱释放消防计划，在那里他和其他囚犯以及精英消防员合作扑灭不可预测的大规模火势， 这是项高风险、高回报的任务。当 Bode 被分配到他家乡小镇的项目之后， 五年前留下的秘密也逐渐揭开。

items.title: Lupin
items.overview: 灵感源自莫里斯·勒布朗创作的亚森·罗宾系列小说。绅士怪盗阿桑·迪奥普受到亚森·罗宾冒险的启发，凭借智慧与魅力智胜敌人，保护所爱之人。

items.title: 紧急呼救
items.overview: 这部剧讲述了包括警察、消防员和调遣员在内的急救人员的高压经历，他们遇到的最可怕、令人震惊和惊心动魄的情境。这些急救人员必须努力在拯救最脆弱的人与解决他们自己生活中的问题之间取得平衡。该节目取材于生活中急救人员经常面临的难以预料的、令人紧张却又振奋人心的现实事件。

items.title: The Terminal List
items.overview: 改编自杰克·卡尔的系列小说。海豹突击队队长詹姆斯·里斯在一次秘密任务后卷入重重阴谋。从军事行动到国际谍战，他在追寻真相与执行任务的过程中，逐步揭开隐藏在背后的危险势力。

profile.tagline: 你的记忆让你怀疑真相。

items.title: Slow Horses
items.overview: 该剧根据米克·赫伦的同名系列小说改编，故事围绕着军情五处内一个不正常的特务组，以及他们讨人厌的老板：臭名满天下的杰克逊·兰姆。他们在真假难辨的间谍世界中努力着，以保卫英国免受邪恶势力的侵害。

cast.name: 克里斯汀·斯科特·托马斯

items.title: 乔治和曼迪的头婚生活
items.overview: 《小谢尔顿》的衍生剧集。乔治和曼迪在德克萨斯州抚养他们的年轻家庭，同时应对成年、育儿和婚姻的挑战。

related.title: 乡巴佬希尔一家的幸福生活
乔治·伯恩斯和格雷西·艾伦秀

items.title: 警察世家：波士顿
items.overview: 《警察世家：波士顿》是由CBS制作的制作的剧集，讲述前纽约警局探员丹尼·里根在一起涉及其小儿子肖恩的案件后，转而加入波士顿警局。他与莉娜·西尔弗搭档——她出身当地著名警察世家，是家中长女，也是前途无量的“明日之星”。她的祖父彼得斯牧师是波士顿一所历史悠久的浸信会教堂里颇具声望的宗教领袖；他同时是波士顿地区检察官梅·西尔弗的父亲，以及警局总监莎拉·西尔弗（最初称为阿什莉）和新晋巡警乔纳·西尔弗（最初称为艾萨克）的外祖父。

　　Lane是校园爆火 App「Campus Drivers」的创始人，长相迷人，但害怕稳定的亲密关系。

　　一场失恋风波，心碎的Lois意外来到Lane家门口，两人开启"意外同居"。来自两个完全不同世界的男女，产生无法抵挡的吸引力。这场相遇唤醒两人深埋的过往伤痛，当爱情不请自来，一切都充满变数。

tmdb-tv-292741.title: 夜曲
tmdb-tv-292741.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

tmdb-tv-258989.title: The Greatest
tmdb-tv-258989.overview: 1960年奥运会刚刚摘金，年轻拳击手穆罕默德阿里（当时名为卡修斯克莱）便将目光投向了重量级冠军。面对突如其来的名声、自我怀疑、家庭矛盾以及政治动荡的美国，这位百年一遇的天才发现，他最强大的对手不在拳台之上，而在这个尚未准备好让他成为真正自己的社会之中。

tmdb-tv-330613.original_title: กฎหลังเที่ยงคืน
tmdb-tv-330613.overview: 梅塔是一个背负着无法抹去过往的男人，在失去全部家人和原本应有的未来后，独自艰难抚养女儿。经济压力所迫，他接受了一份便利店夜班工作。起初这看似只是一份普通差事，但很快他便发现这家便利店隐藏着诸多难以预料的神秘之处，而店里的“规则”远非寻常。

tmdb-tv-314271.title: 巴斯X机甲
tmdb-tv-314271.overview: 在西部蒸汽朋克世界中，法外之徒、机器与超自然力量肆虐横行，一位父亲被迫身兼法官、陪审团与刽子手，只为保护自己的家人。

related.title: Check It Out! with Dr. Steve Brule

tmdb-tv-231620.title: 现在就出发
tmdb-tv-231620.overview: 《现在就出发》是由腾讯视频出品，一生向扬联合出品出的户外真人秀 。节目一方面为观众展现了祖国引人入胜的山河风光、自然美景，另一方面展现出嘉宾们与大自然相处的生活观，带领观众一起逃离都市水泥森林，打造秘境里的充电之旅。

tmdb-tv-248830.title: Stick
tmdb-tv-248830.overview: 前职业高尔夫球手普莱斯·卡希尔在职业生涯受挫、婚姻破裂后，决定培养一名天赋出众却问题缠身的17岁少年桑提。在高尔夫球场内外，两人逐渐建立起特殊的关系，也各自寻找人生的新方向。

related.title: 妖精的尾巴 百年任务

imdb-tt7441658.title: 黑色五叶草
imdb-tt7441658.overview: 两个孤儿一起长大，情同手足，却为争夺这个世界最高的魔法等级“魔法帝”的称号成为了对手。

tmdb-tv-300146.title: 嫁金钗
tmdb-tv-300146.overview: 改编自笑佳人的同名小说。阿丑因容貌酷似侯府千金，意外成为国公府世子陆濯的冲喜新娘。陆濯苏醒后对她百般提防，另一名与她容貌相同的女子也对她恨之入骨。身处危机四伏的国公府，阿丑步步谋划，逐渐改写命运，并揭开身世之谜。

imdb-tt0388629.title: 航海王
imdb-tt0388629.overview: 拥有财富、名声、势力，拥有整个世界的海贼王 – 哥尔·D·罗杰，他在临刑前的一句话，让人们趋之若鹜奔向大海。“想要我的财宝吗？想要的话可以全部给你，去找吧！我把所有财宝都放在那里。”于是所有男子汉航向伟大的航路追逐梦想，世界开始迎接“大海贼时代”。

tmdb-tv-293610.title: Doctor X：白色黑手党时代
tmdb-tv-293610.overview: 一名神秘且出色的外科医生来到一家人人自大、腐败横行的医院，面对强烈的反对，接手看似无法医治的病例。

tmdb-tv-153312.title: 塔尔萨之王
tmdb-tv-153312.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

tmdb-movie-1538497.title: 魔法秘境
tmdb-movie-1538497.overview: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。

tmdb-movie-1100099.title: 时间里的爱人
tmdb-movie-1100099.overview: 阿尔穆特与托比亚斯因一次意外相遇，人生从此改变。两人相恋、组建家庭，在时间的考验与生活的变故中，学会珍惜彼此相伴的每一刻。

tmdb-movie-1812386.title: 向阳青春
tmdb-movie-1812386.overview: 高中生夏薇零（肖雨晴 饰），长期困在母亲（李颖 饰） 的严密管控里，学业、选择、交友全都被安排妥当。曾经顺从的她，终于在压抑里爆发，逃课、反抗，和好友宋飞（张恒铭 饰）、陆欢（张婧岚 饰）一起，拼命夺回属于自己的空间。母女之间争吵不断，误会层层叠加，那句沉甸甸的 “我都是为了你”，慢慢变成刺伤彼此的利刃。一边是母亲寄托全部人生的期待，一边是女孩想要自主成长的渴望。这场没有赢家的家庭战争，能否找到和解的出口？这是属于无数青春期孩子的挣扎，也是每个家长都要面对的一课。

tmdb-movie-1239037.title: 深度安静
tmdb-movie-1239037.overview: 影片改编自林秀赫同名短篇小说。讲述谕明与依庭相遇于大学图书馆里的深度安静区，两人相爱并走入婚姻，正期待迎接第一个孩子。然而，依庭的意外自杀让谕明陷入混乱与痛苦。他想起依庭在怀孕后变得异常，甚至提出离婚。自责的谕明照顾起依庭的家人，透过深入了解她的家庭后，开始理解她的行径，以及她无法面对自己父亲的原因，真相却让人难以接受。

tmdb-movie-925725.title: 霹雳英雄：素还真
tmdb-movie-925725.overview: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

related.title: 安娜·妮可·史密斯：你们不了解我

tmdb-movie-1529692.title: 夫妻一场
tmdb-movie-1529692.overview: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

tmdb-movie-1567259.title: 试探
tmdb-movie-1567259.overview: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

tmdb-movie-1817684.title: 孤楼夜幽灵
tmdb-movie-1817684.overview: 女子林欣因一次意外而丧失记忆，雨夜，别墅里发生诡异事件，女儿失踪。二十年过去，林欣恢复记忆，再次回到女儿失踪的地方，找到女儿，揭开了二十年前发生在母女亲情背后的真相。

tmdb-tv-764.title: 骇人命案事件簿
tmdb-tv-764.overview: 《骇人命案事件簿》是英国独立电视台制作的一部长青推理电影集，取材于英国当代推理小说家Caroline Graham的作品，该剧以总督察Tom Barnaby以及他的年轻拍档Troy为主干，讲述二人凭借机智抽丝剥茧，悉破复杂凶案的故事 ，此外这两个人在查案过程中所不时表现出的幽默机智、亦庄亦谐也是此片受欢迎的原因之一。全剧在英国南部白金汉郡取景拍摄，漂亮的小村庄充满了浓浓的英伦风味，与命案本身的骇人听闻形成强烈反衬，为英式推理迷以及克里斯蒂小说爱好者们的必看之作。

tmdb-tv-79481.title: 斗破苍穹
tmdb-tv-79481.overview:
萧炎曾是家族里公认的斗气天才，年仅11岁便已经抵达了常人穷尽一生都无法修炼到的境界。可12岁那年，一场意外让萧炎的全部努力都化为了乌有，失去一切的他体会到了人情的冷暖和世态的炎凉，之后，萧炎和纳兰嫣然许下了决斗的三年之约，来到魔兽山脉，在身世神秘的药老手下修炼。三年间，萧炎的身影穿梭在塔戈尔大沙漠和加玛帝国黑岩城等地，结识了云芝、小医仙等志同道合的好友，并且最终获得了强大的力量。三年一晃眼就过去了，萧炎毫无悬念的战胜了纳兰嫣然，却没想到，他的故事和劫难才刚刚开始。

tmdb-tv-223397.title: 上帝之城：斗争蔓延
tmdb-tv-223397.original_title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
tmdb-tv-223397.overview: 聚焦里约热内卢贫民区的残酷故事，“魔鬼也会叹息着转身的地方”。这部新的剧集继续由电影版导演费尔南多·梅里尔斯打造，他透露：电影讲的是当地社区的缺陷，剧版则将讲述这些社区的力量。

tvdb-show-478752.title: Overgeared
tvdb-show-478752.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

tmdb-tv-216467.title: 夜樱家的大作战
tmdb-tv-216467.overview:
「这个家庭非比寻常！？」　

高中生「朝野太阳」，因为事故而痛失了家人，心灵也因此变得十分封闭。在班上的同学，大家对他的印象都是”超．内向”，唯一能够与之交谈的是他的青梅竹马「夜樱六美」，但是六美却有一个秘密！？

她的真实身份是代代相传的间谍家族的当家，还一直受到各种敌人性命的威胁。而且她的哥哥「凶一郎」是最凶狠的间谍，对六美表现出异常的溺爱。太阳发现，自己已经成为凶一郎“排除”的目标，生命岌岌可危…！

为了守护六美以及自己的性命安全，太阳采取的手段居然是与六美结婚，成为夜樱家的女婿！？

围绕着太阳、六美以及夜樱家前所未闻的「大作战」让人目不转睛！

tvdb-show-320423.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
tvdb-show-320423.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

tvdb-show-459942.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

tmdb-tv-223911.title: 仙逆
tmdb-tv-223911.overview: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。

tmdb-tv-263208.title: 羞耻(克罗地亚版)
tmdb-tv-263208.overview: 该剧以克罗地亚首都萨格勒布为背景，将于2024年秋季开始在HRT1上播出。

tvmaze-episode-3772773.title: Fool in Love
tvmaze-episode-3772773.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

tmdb-tv-236534.title: 牧神记
tmdb-tv-236534.overview: 主角秦牧，幼时被一女尸托举至涌江边并被司婆婆捡到，村长根据玉佩上的字为其取名为“秦牧”。被一只母牛哺乳长大，是天生凡体，但被村长骗为霸体，修炼霸体三丹功。后走出大墟闯荡，进入京城，拜入太学院。历经考验成为天魔教教主，并被延康国封为第一任太学博士。秦牧在延康国叛乱之战中引来魔神，掀起浩荡风云，后随武可汗入楼兰黄金宫，一个人打遍圣宫无敌手，麻翻无数大巫，盗走无数珍宝。后返回延康，助国师平叛、入京城斩杀太子、造射日神炮。秦牧得人皇传承成为新一代人皇。机缘巧合下遇到了亲生父亲，揭开了自己的身世，借助道门小玉京等人的帮助，开启了道法神通改革的大世。一步步逐渐成长，作为延康变法三杰之一，为芸芸众生而战。

tvmaze-episode-3790950.title: Tigers Sniff the Rose
tvmaze-episode-3790950.overview: Defying the fate laid out for her, Princess Mu Wanyao joins forces with Yan Shang, a young man of humble origins with an unrivaled gift for strategy, to forge a realm of peace and prosperity. With larger-than-life characters, thrilling twists, and exhilarating triumphs, the story follows a generation of young idealists who rise amid the storms of a troubled age, determined to shape the world around them and pursue their dreams.

tmdb-tv-456.title: 辛普森一家
tmdb-tv-456.overview: 辛普森一家是来自美国普通的五口之家，荷马是春田镇核能工厂的安全检查员，母亲马芝曾经是一个很有思想的女性，自从嫁给荷马后渐渐地适应了主妇生活的定式。巴特是家中的长子，天性顽皮的巴特经常爱玩一些恶作剧，以至于经常惹麻烦。妹妹丽莎是一个很聪明的孩子，同时还是素食主义者，佛教徒，爵士乐。小女马姬是一个永远长不大的孩子。故事设定于虚构小镇春田镇，从许多角度对美国的文化与社会、人的条件和电视本身进行了幽默的嘲讽，经久不衰。

tmdb-tv-81723.title: 镀金时代
tmdb-tv-81723.overview: 镀金时代是经济上经历剧变的时期，在新旧钱财来来去去之际，伴随而来的是日益严重的贫富不均。在这变化莫测的时代背景下，本故事始于1882年，年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克是联邦军将领之女，在父亲过世后成了孤儿并搬到纽约的爱格·凡瑞恩和艾达·布鲁克姑姑家。在她身边的还有位才华洋溢，名叫佩姬·史考特的黑人女性。玛丽安不经意地被卷入了姑姑与邻居的社交争斗中。前者是继承大量遗产的名门后代，后者则是坐拥巨额财富且冷酷无情的铁路大亨与其野心勃勃的妻子，乔治与宝莎·罗素。在这新旧交替之际，玛丽安是会循着旧传统的规矩，或是开创新的道路呢？

tmdb-tv-303630.title: 库比蒂诺
tmdb-tv-303630.overview: 一名律师遭前雇主科技初创公司侵吞股票期权。他拒绝妥协，与另一名刚被解雇的律师联手创办律所，帮助遭科技巨头侵害的人们维权，向掌控硅谷的强大企业发起挑战。

tmdb-tv-214162.title: 动物管制官
tmdb-tv-214162.overview:
《废柴联盟》男主Joel McHale将领衔FOX这部半小时工作地点单镜头喜剧。

本剧由《穆迪一家》主创Bob Fisher与Rob Greenberg，《全民追女王》编剧Dan Sterling共同打造。

顾名思义，本剧将围绕着一群负责动物管制官的日常工作和生活展开，所有人都在复杂的工作中认清了一个事实：动物是简单的，而人不是。

Joel将在剧中饰演“Frank”，一个固执、古怪的动物管制官，他或许没有上过大学，但仍然是房间里最博学的人。作为一名曾经的警员，Frank当时试图揭露自己部门的腐败事件缺最终导致他被解雇。这或许可以解释为什么他如此愤世嫉俗和脾气暴躁。在理解动物的方面，Frank展示了过人的能力；但面对同类…他或许不是那么精通。

《疯狂前女友》“Heather”Vella Lovell饰演“Emily”，一个招人喜欢、但偶尔也会有点迟钝尴尬的动物管制团队队长。尽管Emily偶尔在工作中不知所措，但她被自己的队员们深爱着。

《喜当爷》“Ravi”Ravi Patel饰演“Amit Patel”，也同样是团队中的一员；Amit是个不堪重负的居家型男人，承担的家庭责任超出了他的预期。他的搭档与他的生活方式截然不同，彼此可能来自不同的星球。

tmdb-tv-271051.title: 梅格雷探案
tmdb-tv-271051.overview: 《梅格雷探案》是由PBS制作的悬疑犯罪剧集，讲述本杰明·温赖特（《贝尔格莱维亚：新篇章》《指环王：洛希林之战》）饰演朱尔斯·梅格雷——巴黎精英警队“La Crim”的负责人，负责调查巴黎及其周边地区的重大犯罪案件。梅格雷是一位与众不同的年轻探员，渴望证明自己的能力。他调查时锲而不舍，拥有洞察罪犯心理的非凡直觉，以及对巴黎与其居民无与伦比的了解。

tmdb-tv-333101.title: 金银岛
tmdb-tv-333101.overview: 改编自罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森的经典冒险小说。年轻的吉姆·霍金斯和母亲贝斯得到一张传说中的海盗藏宝图，由此踏上横渡大西洋的致命航程。面对叛变、暴力与背叛，吉姆必须在危机四伏的旅途中成长，而这段经历也将彻底改变他的人生。

tmdb-tv-14929.title: 心灵之地
tmdb-tv-14929.overview: 在艾伯塔省山脚下弗莱明斯的牧场上，生活很艰难，在那里受虐待或被忽视的马匹在一个善良而勤奋的家庭中寻求庇护。 负债累累，银行即将取消抵押品赎回权。 他们可以保持牧场运转吗？

tmdb-tv-202224.title: 格里姆斯堡
tmdb-tv-202224.overview: 马文·弗洛特可能是有史以来最伟大的侦探，但他仍然无法解开一个谜团：他的家人，他将遵循每一条线索，与他从未停止过爱的前妻一起救赎自己。

tmdb-tv-1871.title: 东区人
tmdb-tv-1871.overview: 阿尔伯特广场（Albert Square）的工人阶级居民的日常生活，阿尔伯特广场是维多利亚时代的传统露台露台，周围环绕着伦敦沃尔福德区东端的一个公园。

tmdb-tv-214087.title: Universal Basic Guys
tmdb-tv-214087.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

tmdb-tv-231801.title: 极道寿司次郎！
tmdb-tv-231801.overview: 故事背景为近未来的洛杉矶，整座城市被“美食秩序”彻底掌控：顶级主厨的权势堪比黑帮大佬，餐厅就是各方势力的权力中心，为了拿下顶级餐厅的一席位，有人不惜突破底线，不同的烹饪理念更是分化出针锋相对的派系。

tmdb-tv-293943.title: Crossroad Springs
tmdb-tv-293943.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

tmdb-tv-2527.title: 艾玛镇
tmdb-tv-2527.overview: Emmerdale is a British soap focusing on the lives of several families and locals living around an estate, a farm and the nearby village in the Yorkshire Dales. It is the second longest British soap in television history since airing its first episode on ITV in 1972, as 'Emmerdale Farm', the show was renamed in 1989.

tmdb-tv-291.title: 加冕街
tmdb-tv-291.overview: 英国播放时间最长的超级电视肥皂剧（ITV台）。因五十周年剧庆，编剧让其临时转型为灾难剧，目前全街处于灾后重建阶段。

tmdb-tv-298156.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
tmdb-tv-298156.overview: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.

tmdb-tv-80748.title: 联邦调查局
tmdb-tv-80748.overview: 本剧讲述美国联邦调查局纽约办公室的精英团队为保证纽约和国家安全，发挥他们丰富的才能、才智和技术专长的故事。

tmdb-tv-289560.title: 中央情报局
tmdb-tv-289560.overview: 秘密的中情局/联邦调查局联合小组中，特立独行的中情局特工科林·格拉斯与循规蹈矩的联邦调查局特工比尔·古德曼搭档，在纽约执行秘密行动，调查国际阴谋、恐怖组织和地缘政治秘密。

tmdb-tv-12786.title: 神探默多克
tmdb-tv-12786.overview: 故事是发生在1895年的加拿大，主人公默多克是个年轻英俊的侦探，他的破案手段在当时看来都是非传统的，但却破获了一宗又一宗案件，他的上司虽然对他破案手法不屑一顾，但每次破案后又对自己有这么一个下属感到沾沾自喜，但病理学家却对默多克的破案手法很是欣赏，同时为他破案也提供很多 帮助，而默多克也对她日渐迷恋，但又难以启齿。

tmdb-tv-251941.title: 圣丹尼斯医院
tmdb-tv-251941.overview: 由《百味超市》和《百味车厂》的编剧贾斯汀·斯皮泽和埃里克·莱金创作，鲁本·弗雷斯彻执导。讲述了一个位于俄勒冈州资金、人手不足的医院，那里的医生和护士们尽力治疗病人，同时保持自己的理智。

tmdb-tv-291334.title: 雷吉·丁金斯的兴衰
tmdb-tv-291334.original_title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
tmdb-tv-291334.overview: 讲述一位被联盟禁赛的NFL超级巨星雇佣了一位电影制作人拍摄一部关于他生活的纪录片。

imdb-tt42496001.title: Line of Fire
imdb-tt42496001.overview: When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.

tmdb-tv-256106.title: Homestead: The Series
tmdb-tv-256106.overview: A continuation of the movie Homestead... Amid chaos, ex-Green Beret joins prepper compound; love grows, truths arise, and a community unites.

tmdb-tv-987.title: 综合医院
tmdb-tv-987.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

tmdb-tv-881.title: 我们的日子
tmdb-tv-881.overview: 本剧主要描述两个家庭：荷顿(Hortons)家族和布雷迪(Bradys)家族。 很多其他家族也进入到这个团队，并且偶尔露面。荷顿家族的女家长，Frances Reid从该剧成立以来一直参与演出直到2010年2月3日逝世。 Suzanne Rogers在我们的日子38周年庆生会中，回顾她第一次于1973年出场。 Susan Seaforth Hayes 则是唯一的从开播到现在都还在的角色。

tmdb-tv-248361.title: 大门之外
tmdb-tv-248361.overview: 一个权势显赫的家族统治着一个豪华的封闭式社区，这里隐藏着诸多引人入胜的秘密和丑闻，等待着被揭开。

tvdb-show-392598.title: Swallowed Star
tvdb-show-392598.overview: One day, an unexplained RR virus appeared on the earth, drawing the world into disaster. Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

imdb-tt0112004.title: Hollyoaks
imdb-tt0112004.overview: Hollyoaks follows the lives of a group of residents living in the fictional village of Chester.

imdb-tt0364845.title: NCIS
imdb-tt0364845.overview: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it's a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Leroy Jethro Gibbs, a former Marine gunnery sergeant, whose skills as an investigator are unmatched, leads this troupe of colorful personalities. Rounding out the team are Anthony DiNozzo, an ex-homicide detective whose instincts in the field are unparalleled and whose quick wit and humorous take on life make him a team favorite; the youthful and energetic forensic specialist Abby Sciuto, a talented scientist whose sharp mind matches her Goth style and eclectic tastes; Caitlin Todd, an ex-Secret Service Agent; and Timothy McGee, an MIT graduate whose brilliance with computers far overshadows his insecurities in the field; Assisting the team is medical examiner Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard, who knows it all because he's seen it all, and he's not afraid to let you know. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents travel the globe to investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

imdb-tt30796986.title: NCIS: Origins
imdb-tt30796986.overview: In NCIS: Origins, young Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

imdb-tt7631058.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
imdb-tt7631058.original_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
imdb-tt7631058.overview: Set thousands of years before the events of The Lord of the Rings, this epic drama follows an ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, as they confront the long-feared re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth.

imdb-tt36885662.title: Best Medicine
imdb-tt36885662.overview: In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

imdb-tt41814911.title: NCIS: New York
imdb-tt41814911.overview: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

imdb-tt26748321.title: Doc
imdb-tt26748321.overview: Doc centers on the hard-charging, brilliant Dr. Amy Larsen, Chief of Internal and Family Medicine at Westside Hospital in Minneapolis. After a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life, Amy must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves and the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

imdb-tt11231226.title: Reasonable Doubt
imdb-tt11231226.overview: In Reasonable Doubt, you'll judge Jax Stewart for her questionable ethics and wild interpretations of the law... until you're the one in trouble. Then you'll see her for what she is: the most brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system at every chance she gets.

imdb-tt21952924.title: Phony
imdb-tt21952924.overview: Phony is a coming-of-age mystery about a teenager who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to discover his mom - his only parent and his best friend - appears to have been replaced by an impostor.

imdb-tt21906238.title: Rivals
imdb-tt21906238.overview: Rivals dives headfirst into the cut-throat world of independent television in 1986, where the shoulder pads are big and ambitions even bigger. In the fictional upper-class county of Rutshire, a long-standing rivalry between two powerful men is about to boil over: ex-Olympian, Member of Parliament, and notorious womaniser Rupert Campbell-Black, and his Rutshire neighbour Tony Baddingham, controller of the independent TV franchise Corinium Television. As tensions rise and rivalries deepen, there are spilled secrets, forged alliances, and snatched liaisons that draw wives, lovers, colleagues, friends, and families into their battle.

tmdb-tv-295778.title: Scrubs
tmdb-tv-295778.overview: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.

imdb-tt4655480.title: Chicago Med
imdb-tt4655480.overview: An emotional thrill ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's newest state-of-the-art trauma center and into the lives of the courageous doctors, nurses and staff who hold it all together. This is one of those days.

tmdb-tv-125935.title: Abbott Elementary
tmdb-tv-125935.overview: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don't love the school district's less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

imdb-tt2261391.title: Chicago Fire
imdb-tt2261391.overview: No job is more stressful, dangerous or exhilarating than those of the Firefighters, Rescue Squad and Paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51. These are the courageous men and women who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death. These are their stories.

cast.character: Kyle Broflovski / Kenny McCormick / Butters Stotch (voice)

tmdb-tv-2190.title: South Park
tmdb-tv-2190.overview: South Park is an adult comedy animation show centred around 4 children in the small town of south park. Its humour is often dark involving satirical elements and mocking current real-life events.

imdb-tt2805096.title: Chicago P.D.
imdb-tt2805096.overview: District 21 of the Chicago Police Department is made up of two distinctly different groups. There are the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head to head with the city's street crimes. And there's the Intelligence Unit, the team that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond. These are their stories.

imdb-tt31289994.title: The Lowdown
imdb-tt31289994.overview: The Lowdown follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

imdb-tt20859904.title: Mike Judge's Beavis and Butt-Head
imdb-tt20859904.overview: In this new iteration, Beavis and Butt-Head are entering a whole new Gen Z world. Comedy Central has ordered two seasons of the new series with meta-themes relatable to both new and old fans - Gen X parents and their Gen Z kids. Judge is set to write, produce and provide voice over for both iconic characters.

imdb-tt30291387.title: All's Fair
imdb-tt30291387.overview: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

imdb-tt10752770.title: Tyler Perry's Sistas
imdb-tt10752770.overview: A group of single black women from different walks of life navigate their complicated love life status, careers and friendship through the ups-and-downs of living in a modern world of social media and unrealistic relationship goals.

imdb-tt37253101.title: Hunting Alice Bell
imdb-tt37253101.overview: Alice Bell is a former nurse, and also the lover, and accomplice, of a notorious anaesthetist serial killer. She is presently living in Britain under a new identity. When, online, Fran Da Silva is accused of being Alice Bell, her happy family life implodes in a wave of mob hate. Then she discovers she's not the only woman to suffer this fate. Fran and the other accused women band together to fight back and clear their names. But as they battle to prove their innocence, what if one of the group is lying - and is the real Alice Bell…?

tmdb-tv-75219.overview: 9-1-1 is a fast-paced exploration into the lives and careers of first responders – cops, paramedics, firefighters – the people who put their lives on the line to save others.

related.title: 乡巴佬希尔一家的幸福生活
乔治·伯恩斯和格雷西·艾伦秀

tmdb-tv-243875.title: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage
tmdb-tv-243875.overview: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage follows Georgie and Mandy as they raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting and marriage.

imdb-tt0203259.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
imdb-tt0203259.overview: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

imdb-tt26591110.title: Elsbeth
imdb-tt26591110.overview: Elsbeth follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

imdb-tt0098844.title: Law & Order
imdb-tt0098844.overview: In the criminal justice system, the people are represented by two separate, yet equally important, groups: the police, who investigate crime; and the district attorneys, who prosecute the offenders. These are their stories.

profile.tagline: 你拯救的生命也许将是你自己

tmdb-tv-1416.title: Grey's Anatomy
tmdb-tv-1416.overview: The doctors of Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital deal with life-or-death consequences on a daily basis -- it's in one another that they find comfort, friendship and, at times, more than friendship. Together they're discovering that neither medicine nor relationships can be defined in black and white. Real life only comes in shades of grey.

imdb-tt32378211.title: Mistletoe Murders
imdb-tt32378211.overview: Emily Lane is a good-natured Christmas shop owner with a secret past. When local murders begin to pop up in Fletcher's Grove, Emily can't help but to use her unique talents from her past life to help solve murders that affect people in her new life. She crosses paths with Detective Sam Wilner who she starts to make a connection with, until he comes to learn there is more to Emily than meets the eye.

imdb-tt33078239.title: Eternally Yours
imdb-tt33078239.overview: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

imdb-tt37972251.title: War
imdb-tt37972251.overview: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.

imdb-tt33550053.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
imdb-tt33550053.overview: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.

imdb-tt31842126.title: The Good Daughter
imdb-tt31842126.overview: The Good Daughter is a suspenseful crime drama where sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she's forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

tmdb-tv-253391.title: Sheriff Country
tmdb-tv-253391.overview: Sheriff Country focuses on straight-shooting sheriff Mickey Fox, the stepsister of Cal Fire's division chief Sharon Leone, who investigates criminal activity as she patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father, Wes, who is an off-the-grid marijuana grower, and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

tmdb-tv-202297.title: Fire Country
tmdb-tv-202297.overview: In Fire Country, seeking redemption and a shortened prison sentence, young convict Bode Donovan joins a firefighting program that returns him to his small Northern California hometown, where he and other inmates work alongside elite firefighters to extinguish massive blazes across the region.

imdb-tt6151526.title: The Rainmaker
imdb-tt6151526.overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head-to-head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend. Rudy, along with his boss and her disheveled paralegal, uncover two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

tmdb-tv-284736.title: Boston Blue
tmdb-tv-284736.overview: In Boston Blue, NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a position with Boston PD. Once in Boston, he is paired with Detective Lena Silver, the eldest daughter of a prominent law enforcement family.

imdb-tt31106862.title: Happy's Place
imdb-tt31106862.overview: Happy's Place follows Bobbie who inherits her father's restaurant and is less than thrilled to discover that she has a new business partner in the half-sister she never knew she had.

imdb-tt39469996.title: Newlyweds
imdb-tt39469996.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

imdb-tt39980704.title: Yaga
imdb-tt39980704.overview: Yaga follows Rapp, a private investigator who arrives in a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery, Henry Park. Rapp finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, Carson, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, Katherine, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

imdb-tt0206512.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
imdb-tt0206512.overview: Come follow the adventures of the world's most lovable sponge and his starfish sidekick! imdb-tt36329495.title: Honey
imdb-tt36329495.overview: Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.
